_comment: Recorded Saaras v4 verbatim-mode response shape, used verbatim by app/sarvam/stt.py when client.live() is False. Mirrors sarvamai.types.SpeechToTextResponse (request_id, transcript, language_code, language_probability); diarized_transcript is this build's own addition for the batch/mock route, not a field Saaras guarantees.
